$comment: Single source of the workspace test-coverage floor (CLAUDE.md Rule 14). Every project's `vitest.config.*` reads `thresholds` from here instead of restating the four numbers, so the floor is one edit and no project can sit below it while looking compliant. Consumers: every vitest config in the workspace, and shared/tools/dev-cli/src/check-project-conventions.mjs, whose vitest-seam rule requires a project that has tests to read this file rather than declare its own numbers. The value lives at the repo root rather than inside one project because a cross-project source import would be an edge the Nx project graph cannot see — the same reason journey-markers.config.json, languages.config.json and practice-index.json sit here. nx.json's `coverageConfig` named input puts this file in every test target's cache key, so a change to the floor re-runs the suites it governs instead of replaying a cached green.
